evidence.title: When More Modalities Hurt: Modality Dropout for Heavy-Duty Vehicle Engine Diagnostics

summary: Researchers propose a modality dropout technique to enhance AI performance in diagnosing heavy-duty vehicle engine issues by selectively ignoring certain data inputs. The method aims to prevent over-reliance on redundant or noisy modalities, improving robustness in real-world applications.
title: Modality Dropout Improves AI Diagnostics for Heavy-Duty Vehicle Engines
